rule: Wraiths drain mire-essence from lit lanterns
texts: When a wraith approaches a lit lantern, the wraith drains mire-essence from the lantern.
Whenever a wraith nears a lit lantern, the wraith pulls mire-essence from the lantern.

fields.sentence: When a wraith approaches a lit lantern, the wraith drains mire-essence from the lantern.
parse: (: wraith_drain_rule (Implication (And (Member $w wraith) (Member $l lantern) (Member $l lit) (Member $e1 approach) (Agent $e1 $w) (Theme $e1 $l)) (And (Member (sk_drain $e1) drain) (Agent (sk_drain $e1) $w) (Theme (sk_drain $e1) mire_essence) (Source (sk_drain $e1) $l) (During (sk_drain $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))
